name: YouTube Studio — Topic Queue ➜ Render ➜ Upload (4 channels)

parameters.jsCode:
// Per-channel identity, voice and SEO defaults.
// Mirrors youtube-studio/channels/*.json — keep the two in sync when a channel changes.
const CHANNELS = {
  'WealthMind AI': {
    slug: 'wealthmind-ai',
    niche: 'Finance / Wealth explainers',
    priority: 1,
    rpm: '$10-15 RPM',
    voiceName: 'Marcus',
    voiceEnv: 'ELEVENLABS_VOICE_WEALTHMIND_AI',
    categoryId: '27',
    brandVoice:
      'Authoritative yet accessible. Actionable wealth-building strategies, market analysis and the psychology of money. Professional, forward-looking, highly trustworthy.',
    audience: 'Working professionals 25-45 who want to build wealth without a finance degree.',
    styleRules: [
      'Open with a number, a mistake or a counter-intuitive claim in the first sentence.',
      'Explain one idea per paragraph, in plain English, with a concrete dollar example.',
      'Never give individual investment advice; frame as education and cite the mechanism, not a prediction.',
      'Close by pointing at the affiliate tool as the practical next step.',
    ],
    targetWords: 1100,
    footageQueries: [
      'modern city skyline aerial',
      'stock market chart screen',
      'business person reviewing documents',
      'luxury watch close up',
      'calculator money desk',
    ],
    defaultTags: ['personal finance', 'wealth building', 'investing for beginners', 'money mindset', 'financial freedom'],
    affiliate: { product: 'TradingView', url: '', commission: '30% recurring' },
    thumbnail: { palette: ['#0B1F3A', '#C9A227', '#FFFFFF'], font: 'Montserrat ExtraBold' },
  },
  'Justice Told': {
    slug: 'justice-told',
    niche: 'Betrayal / Revenge narratives',
    priority: 2,
    rpm: '$5-8 RPM',
    voiceName: 'Ethan',
    voiceEnv: 'ELEVENLABS_VOICE_JUSTICE_TOLD',
    categoryId: '24',
    brandVoice:
      'Gripping, dramatic, slightly mysterious. Real-life stories of overcoming betrayal and reaching poetic justice. Suspenseful, empathetic to the victim, satisfying in conclusion.',
    audience: 'Story-hungry viewers 18-45 who watch true-story narration to the end.',
    styleRules: [
      'Cold open on the betrayal moment, then rewind to how it started.',
      'Withhold the outcome until the final third; end every paragraph on a hook.',
      'Never name real private individuals; keep stories composite and clearly framed as dramatised.',
      'No revenge instructions — the payoff is legal, social or karmic.',
    ],
    targetWords: 1400,
    footageQueries: [
      'rain window night city',
      'empty courtroom hallway',
      'silhouette walking dark street',
      'old letters close up',
      'wedding ring on table',
    ],
    defaultTags: ['true story', 'betrayal story', 'revenge story', 'storytime', 'dramatic narration'],
    affiliate: { product: 'Incogni', url: '', commission: '35% commission' },
    thumbnail: { palette: ['#7B0D1E', '#000000', '#FFFFFF'], font: 'Bebas Neue' },
  },
  'GoldenYears Guide': {
    slug: 'goldenyears-guide',
    niche: 'Senior health & wellness',
    priority: 3,
    rpm: '$5-8 RPM (high-CPM senior demographic)',
    voiceName: 'Dorothy',
    voiceEnv: 'ELEVENLABS_VOICE_GOLDENYEARS_GUIDE',
    categoryId: '27',
    brandVoice:
      'Gentle, encouraging and respectful. Longevity, simple exercises, nutrition for seniors and mental well-being. Warm, patient, community-oriented.',
    audience: 'Adults 60+ and the family members who look after them.',
    styleRules: [
      'Speak slowly and warmly; short sentences, no jargon.',
      'Every health claim must be framed as general wellbeing, with "talk to your doctor first".',
      'Give one thing the viewer can do today, seated or at home.',
      'Never promise a cure, a diagnosis or a specific medical outcome.',
    ],
    targetWords: 950,
    footageQueries: [
      'senior couple walking park',
      'healthy breakfast table sunlight',
      'senior woman stretching living room',
      'grandparents laughing garden',
      'fresh vegetables close up',
    ],
    defaultTags: ['senior health', 'healthy aging', 'exercises for seniors', 'retirement wellness', 'nutrition after 60'],
    affiliate: { product: 'SilverSneakers', url: '', commission: 'lead-based' },
    thumbnail: { palette: ['#8FBF9F', '#8CC7E8', '#F6C9A8'], font: 'Playfair Display' },
  },
  'FluentFast AI': {
    slug: 'fluentfast-ai',
    niche: 'English learning (ESL)',
    priority: 4,
    rpm: '$5-8 RPM (global evergreen audience)',
    voiceName: 'Serena',
    voiceEnv: 'ELEVENLABS_VOICE_FLUENTFAST_AI',
    categoryId: '27',
    brandVoice:
      'High-energy, supportive and clear. Practical phrases, common mistakes and immersive learning. Educational, fast-paced, globally inclusive.',
    audience: 'Intermediate English learners worldwide, mobile-first viewers.',
    styleRules: [
      'Model the phrase, then explain the mistake, then drill it three times.',
      'Keep sentences under 14 words; define any hard word inline.',
      'Use a neutral American accent reference in the narration.',
      'End with one practice sentence the viewer can repeat out loud.',
    ],
    targetWords: 900,
    footageQueries: [
      'students studying together cafe',
      'person speaking presentation',
      'world map travel',
      'notebook english handwriting',
      'friends conversation laughing',
    ],
    defaultTags: ['learn english', 'english speaking practice', 'english grammar', 'esl', 'english phrases'],
    affiliate: { product: 'Italki', url: '', commission: '$15 per new student' },
    thumbnail: { palette: ['#FFD400', '#1B4FD8', '#FFFFFF'], font: 'Poppins Bold' },

};

const MODEL = $env.OPENAI_MODEL || 'gpt-4o';
const runStamp = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, '-');

return $input.all().map((item) => {
  const row = item.json;
  const channel = String(row['Channel'] || '').trim();
  const config = CHANNELS[channel];
  if (!config) {
    throw new Error(
      `Unknown channel "${channel}" in row "${row['Topic']}". Allowed values: ${Object.keys(CHANNELS).join(', ')}. Fix the Channel dropdown in the ContentPipeline sheet.`,
    );
  }
  const voiceId = String($env[config.voiceEnv] || '').trim();
  const notes = String(row['Notes'] || '').trim();
  const affiliateUrl = String(row['Affiliate Link'] || '').trim() || config.affiliate.url;

  const systemPrompt = [
    `You are the head writer for "${channel}", a faceless YouTube channel about ${config.niche}.`,
    `Brand voice: ${config.brandVoice}`,
    `Audience: ${config.audience}`,
    'House rules:',
    ...config.styleRules.map((rule) => `- ${rule}`),
    'You write narration only. No scene directions, no speaker labels, no markdown, no emoji.',
    'You never invent statistics, studies, names or quotes. If a number is needed, keep it generic and obviously illustrative.',
  ].join('\n');

  const userPrompt = [
    `Write a complete YouTube narration script on this topic: "${row['Topic']}".`,
    `Target length: about ${config.targetWords} words (roughly ${Math.round(config.targetWords / 150)} minutes of speech).`,
    notes ? `Editor notes to respect: ${notes}` : '',
    affiliateUrl ? `The affiliate partner for this video is ${config.affiliate.product} (${affiliateUrl}). Mention it once, naturally, near the end.` : '',
    '',
    'Return ONLY valid JSON with this exact shape:',
    '{',
    '  "hook": "one or two spoken sentences that open the video and earn the next 30 seconds",',
    '  "script": "the full narration as plain spoken text, paragraphs separated by \\n\\n",',
    '  "summary": "3 sentence summary of what the video covers",',
    '  "footage_queries": ["5 short Pexels stock-footage search queries, 2-5 words each, visual and concrete"],',
    '  "suggested_title": "a working title under 70 characters"',
    '}',
  ].filter(Boolean).join('\n');

  const openai_body = {
    model: MODEL,
    temperature: 0.8,
    response_format: { type: 'json_object' },
    messages: [
      { role: 'system', content: systemPrompt },
      { role: 'user', content: userPrompt },
    ],
  };

  return {
    json: {
      ...row,
      channel_slug: config.slug,
      niche: config.niche,
      priority: config.priority,
      rpm_target: config.rpm,
      brand_voice: config.brandVoice,
      style_rules: config.styleRules,
      target_words: config.targetWords,
      voice_id: voiceId,
      voice_name: config.voiceName,
      // MoneyPrinterTurbo speaks ElevenLabs voices in this exact format.
      mpt_voice_name: `elevenlabs:${voiceId}:${config.voiceName}`,
      category_id: config.categoryId,
      default_tags: config.defaultTags,
      default_footage_queries: config.footageQueries,
      affiliate_product: config.affiliate.product,
      affiliate_url: affiliateUrl,
      affiliate_commission: config.affiliate.commission,
      thumbnail_palette: config.thumbnail.palette,
      thumbnail_font: config.thumbnail.font,
      editor_notes: notes,
      run_stamp: runStamp,
      audio_filename: `${config.slug}-${runStamp}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}.mp3`,
      openai_body,
    },
  };
});

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ text: $json.tts_text, model_id: ($env.ELEVENLABS_MODEL || 'eleven_multilingual_v2'), voice_settings: { stability: 0.45, similarity_boost: 0.75, style: 0.25, use_speaker_boost: true } }) }}

parameters.content:
## YouTube Studio — topic row ➜ rendered ➜ uploaded

Runs daily 08:00 UTC. Reads the `ContentPipeline` sheet, keeps rows where Script Status = Pending AND Video Status = Pending, and takes at most one row per channel (MAX_VIDEOS_PER_RUN, default 4).

### Before activating
1. `youtube-studio/.env` filled in (see youtube-studio/.env.template — every key is marked FREE or PAID).
2. Credentials created in n8n and attached to the three Google Sheets nodes and the YouTube node: **Google Sheets OAuth2** and **YouTube OAuth2**.
3. Sheet columns exactly as in `youtube-studio/sheets-schema.md` (ContentPipeline). Rows are matched on Channel + Topic.

### When a key is missing
The "Validate Config (fail loud)" node stops the run with the exact key name, whether it is free or paid, and where to get it. Nothing is generated or charged before that gate.

### Narration / TTS
`ELEVENLABS_NARRATION=hook` (default) synthesises only the hook — a cheap, loud check that the key and voice id work, saved to /data/youtube-audio for the Shorts cut.
`ELEVENLABS_NARRATION=full` synthesises the whole script as a master narration file (full ElevenLabs credit spend).

The render itself gets its audio from MoneyPrinterTurbo's own ElevenLabs provider (`voice_name = elevenlabs:<voice_id>:<name>`) because MPT's HTTP API only accepts custom audio that already lives inside the task directory it creates. Same voice, one paid synthesis per video.

### Render + upload
POST `/api/v1/videos` with the Pexels clips we picked (`video_materials`), then poll `GET /api/v1/tasks/{id}` every 20s.
state 1 = complete, -1 = failed, anything else keeps polling (bounded by MPT_MAX_POLLS, default 60 ≈ 20 min).

On success: SEO metadata from the youtube-seo-prompt.md template, download the mp4, upload, and write Video Status = Uploaded + Published URL + SEO Status = Done back to the sheet.
On any failure: Video Status = Error with the reason in Notes, then the run stops with an error so it is visible in n8n.
